<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary Delimitation:</strong> The government is reportedly planning a special session of Parliament to introduce the Delimitation Bill, drawing criticism from opposition leaders who allege a lack of transparency and consultation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission Scrutiny:</strong> Opposition parties, including the INDIA bloc, are challenging the Election Commission’s recent actions and administrative decisions, with plans to address alleged procedural defects.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>US-India Legislative Ties:</strong> A bipartisan bill has been introduced in the U.S. Congress to establish a formal dialogue mechanism between the U.S. Congress and the Indian Parliament to strengthen bilateral relations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPc045ZzkyZW1IbEtLLTB2a0Z1QXkybGdBLVp4cW53cEI1VnFyTC12Z3N2dEJRYUxWM1NhVnIxWE11dDZkZnM5aWZGQ1Y5LUUtOURCSV9MYS1zeHZqMnlSVGliMkxialFxQWpPYWNPd2pobVdfVkN6T0ptSzBpRXZoYkdfM1hnUG1YeURGY0NfQl83ZV9UOF8zRTlnNU5MX21DaGdjTENkUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Digital Rights:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that internet access is a fundamental right, explicitly rejecting the implementation of blanket age-based bans for children.</li>
  <li><strong>Infrastructure Development:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved the four-laning of the Dhamasiya–Bitada/Movi and Nasarpore–Malotha sections of National Highway-56 in Gujarat at a cost of Rs 4,583.64 crore.</li>
</ul>
